findings.review: Single straight sighting telescope over horizontal brass graduated circle and compass, attached vertical angle arc; all components grouped on one mounting stem and a three-leg wooden tripod. Natural muted brass/brown wood, dark joints, transparent exterior and gaps; no gabion, map, floor, frame, text or global blue cast. Telescope, circle and tripod silhouette readable at 48/64 px on light/dark backgrounds.
findings.limits: Stylized historic surveying concept, not a measured reconstruction or certification of mechanically accurate operation. Fine ticks disappear at 32 px. The tripod is a conceptual period support, not reproduced from the catalog photo; the upper circle has more visual weight than the legs.
